statements.t: During the three months ended September 30, 2026, we assessed the periods over which we expect to satisfy the performance obligations under the CHI Agreements based on our current transition progress.
We will substantially complete the transition by October 30, 2026 rather than December 31, 2026, as originally expected.

We anticipate that our capital expenditures for the year ending December 31, 2026 will total approximately $700 million to $800 million, including $111 million that was accrued as a liability at December 31, 2025.

We believe that existing cash and cash equivalents on hand, borrowing availability under our Credit Agreement and anticipated future cash provided by our operating activities are adequate to meet our current cash needs.
From time to time, we expect to engage in additional capital markets, bank credit and other financing activities depending on our needs and the financing alternatives available at that time.
